Name: Amazon QA Testing – Web/mobileApp
Description:
This project covers testing of key user journeys :

including registration, login/authentication, navigation, product browsing, checkout, input validation, and mobile-specific behavior.

The goal is to identify ,reproduce, document, and prioritize meaningful defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, severity/priority, environment details, and supporting evidence.
